subject: Action: manager commitments after engagement pulse (sensitive attrition flag)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Solutions <peopleops@peopleops-consult.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Action: manager commitments after engagement pulse (sensitive attrition flag)

Team —

Thanks for reviewing the Q2 engagement pulse. I’ve attached the summary and a manager action tracker skeleton. Two asks from me:

1) Please confirm (by EOD today) the manager-level commitments for your direct reports and an ETA for each action.
2) If you have any high-priority attrition risks, flag them inline and mark whether you want PeopleOps looped in for escalation/retention support.

Sensitive note: there is a case flagged by the engineering leads — a senior infra engineer who has had 2 low engagement items and submitted a resignation-sounding note in a 1:1. I’m keeping names restricted here; Marcus, can you confirm whether you’ve had follow-ups and whether we should initiate retention outreach? If yes, indicate preferred PeopleOps involvement.

Attachments: engagement_pulse_summary_Q2.pdf, manager_action_tracker_skeleton.xlsx

High-level priorities I want captured in the tracker (please use the attached template):
- Concrete manager actions (1:1 cadence changes, project adjustments)
- Timing (next 7/30/90 days)
- Success criteria / signals to close the item
- Any blockers that require leadership/PeopleOps support

I’ll collate responses and run a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10am PT if there’s value — let me know if you cannot make it.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Reliability & People Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: manager commitments after engagement pulse (sensitive attrition flag)

Vanessa —

Thanks for the summary and template. Short answers:

- I’ll fill the action tracker by 3pm PT today for my org (infra + platform).
- The individual you referenced is on my infra squad. I had a candid 1:1 two weeks ago after the pulse; they expressed frustration with on-call load and lack of growth clarity. I scheduled follow-ups but have not had a retention conversation yet.
- I want PeopleOps involved if we plan a retention outreach or offer. If we’re only doing manager-level intervention (more 1:1s, scope adjustment), I’ll proceed with those first and update tracker.

Immediate steps I’m committing to:
- Two-week cadence 1:1 for the next month (first check yesterday completed).
- Re-scope on-call rotations to reduce asymmetric load (owner: Marcus; ETA: 7/2).
- Draft growth plan with clear milestones by 7/9.

If PeopleOps can prepare a standard retention outreach playbook and a calibrated offer range (if we get there), that would be helpful. Cc’ing PeopleOps so they see the ask.

—Marcus

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: manager commitments after engagement pulse (sensitive attrition flag)

Vanessa / all —

I’ll populate the tracker by 4pm PT and am scheduling dedicated 1:1s with my directs who showed early warning signals. A couple of notes:

- For any case where we suspect resignation intent, please mark the row as "HIGH-RISK" and include the date of the last substantive 1:1 and any stated reasons. That helps PeopleOps prioritize.
- I agree with Marcus that manager-first interventions make sense for 1–2 weeks unless we hit explicit resignation signals. If we escalate to PeopleOps, I want to include manager notes, recent performance context, and potential retention levers.

Quick blockers: several managers have full schedules next week because of product launch rollouts. If you want retention outreach quickly, I can pause some non-critical syncs, but raise if leadership disagrees.

Neha
People Lead — Product

From: PeopleOps Solutions <peopleops@peopleops-consult.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action: manager commitments after engagement pulse (sensitive attrition flag)

Vanessa / Marcus / Neha / Tessa —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sharing the tracker. We can support in two ways: a discreet retention outreach (manager + PeopleOps joined call) and a standardized offer calibration memo if a counter is appropriate.

We recommend the following immediate steps (which we can execute within 48 hours once you confirm):
- PeopleOps will draft a short retention outreach script for the manager to use (private, 30-min suggested).
- If you elect to prepare an offer, send us the employee level, tenure, current comp band, and any documented performance signals — we’ll return a calibrated memo within 24 hours.
- We can run a confidential stay interview template and summarize signals without broad leadership circulation.

Privacy note: we will not create formal HR records until a manager explicitly requests PeopleOps engagement. Please indicate the employee identifier column in the tracker as a hashed id if you prefer.

Confirm next steps and we’ll stand by.

— PeopleOps Solutions
